title: Overview of central Granada
text: This was a great tour to get a feel for central Granada and the Albaicin area. 1st - the tour operator contacted me via WhatsApp well in advance of our tour to confirm details which gave me confidence about the tour. The night before I received my tour guides contact information. Gabrielle was terrific! She had an energetic and warm personality. Worth the help of an iPad she helped us understand the history and geography of Granada. We walked through the main sites in the center of town. title: Special
text: The guided tour was very special; Paco guided us with a lot of passion and attention, he was very well prepared and it was very fun! :)
author: lety_paolini

title: Top rated
text: The best 2.5 hours of my trip. I learnt so much from the wonderful Marta who guided us. She provided all the information necessary to enable us to appreciate the wonderful history of the city.
author: forshaw52

title: The perfect introduction to Granada.
text: The four of us thoroughly enjoyed our private walking tour of Granada City Center and Albaicin with our tour guide Marta. She was knowledgeable and upbeat and seemed to really enjoy being a guide. She never rushed us and answered all our questions. The tour covered many main attractions in the city and was the perfect introduction to our week in the area. I would highly recommend the private tour with Marta.
author: jillg221

title: Excellent tour
text: An excellent ‘pay what you want’ tour and guide Fina was very charming and knowledgeable and spoke perfect English
author: John1799856

title: Very good guide, key points, easy to book!
text: The visit with our guide Javier was excellent; it was very complete, interesting, and of course, he inspired us to keep learning history while walking through Granada!
author: Fearless13038588738

title: Informative and fun tour of fascinating Granada
text: Nacho was personable, informative and very well equipped to share the history of fascinating Granada both from a historical perspective and a personal one as a resident. We were in excellent hands and saw parts of the city that we would not have appreciated without a well intended guide.
author: Lori_C

title: To start the visit to Granada
text: A very complete visit to the historic center and neighborhood Albaicín. Marta, the guide gave it all the buzz so we can understand the story with a lot of humor. It was great 👍🏻
author: guillej457

title: Private tour of Granada city center and the Albacin
text: Marta was an excellent guide well versed in both the historical and cultural aspects of the areas we toured as well as being both professional and personable.
author: josanneg918

title: Wonderful intro to Granada!
text: We did the Granada Essentials tour. Our guide was either Alberto or Roberto. Excellent tour! Our guide was knowledgeable, funny, so engaged. Couldn’t be better. Do this tour!!!
